name: home-stock-manager

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/server && npm run lint -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w packages/server && npm run test -w packages/client

description: Family home stock manager for groceries, medicines, and household items.
